method.method_draft: Read the diagram as rhombus ABCD with side CB labeled 6 and DA as another side of the same rhombus. From the text, use the fact that ABCD is a rhombus. By definition, all four sides of a rhombus are congruent, so DA = CB. Since CB = 6, DA = 6. The angle information is not needed for the length.
